nodes.label: Community Section Banner
nodes.description: Outdoor running scene at golden hour/sunset. Two young adults (male and female) jogging together in a park-like setting, both smiling and wearing matching black athletic wear (tank tops and shorts). The male wears a Nike tank top; the female wears an Under Armour sports bra and shorts with a fitness wristwatch. Background features lush green trees and a warm orange-yellow sunset sky. The image conveys energy, joy, companionship, and active community participation.
nodes.visual_style: High-quality lifestyle photography with warm, golden tones. Shallow depth of field focuses on the runners while blurring the background, creating a cinematic feel. Dynamic motion blur on the female runner's hair reinforces a sense of speed and vitality.
nodes.purpose: Hero/banner image for the Community section of the IFit app. Establishes the social and motivational tone of the community feature — that fitness is better shared. Communicates inclusivity (diverse pair), positivity (smiling), and real-world activity.
nodes.design_decisions: Warm sunset palette complements the app's dark (#222831) theme by providing a high-contrast, visually striking header. The energetic outdoor running context aligns with the app's fitness identity. Social pairing of two users reinforces the community/social engagement message.
nodes.communicates_to_users: You are part of a fitness community — training together is motivating and fun. The community section is a social, active, and welcoming space.

nodes.label: Golden Hour Photography Style
nodes.description: Photographic technique using natural sunset light (golden hour) to create warm, flattering, and emotionally resonant imagery. Common in lifestyle and fitness marketing to evoke aspiration and energy.

nodes.label: Social Fitness Visual Concept
nodes.description: Design concept of depicting fitness as a shared, social activity rather than an individual pursuit. Used in community-focused fitness apps to reduce intimidation and increase engagement by showing relatable peer interactions.

nodes.label: Hero Banner UI Pattern
nodes.description: Full-width image placed at the top of a screen section to establish context, mood, and identity before content. A common UI/UX pattern in mobile apps to give screens a strong visual entry point.
